metadata.title: dIKta.me - Private AI Voice Dictation for Windows
metadata.description: Open-source local AI voice dictation for Windows. Whisper-powered speech-to-text with local LLMs, no cloud, no subscriptions, no compromise on privacy.
metadata.featuresDescription: Explore 48+ features including local Whisper STT, AI-powered editing, voice macros, real-time translation, and text-to-speech — all running privately on your Windows PC.
metadata.aboutDescription: dIKta.me is a local-first, privacy-first voice dictation engine for Windows. Built by a solo indie developer, powered by on-device AI.
metadata.pricingDescription: Free trial or one-time $20 Full Version for local AI + BYOK. MIT open source. No subscriptions, no word limits.
metadata.docsDescription: Complete documentation for dIKta.me — setup guides, core feature walkthroughs, AI engine configuration, hotkey customization, and developer architecture references.
metadata.privacyDescription: How dIKta.me handles your data. Short version: the desktop app is air-gapped and never phones home. The website collects only what it needs.
metadata.termsDescription: Terms of service for dIKta.me. MIT open source, no subscriptions. Plain English, no surprises.
metadata.loginDescription: Sign in to your dIKta.me account to access your dashboard, manage settings, and sync across devices.
metadata.waitlistDescription: Sign up for early access to dIKta.me V2. Local-first AI voice dictation for Windows. Be first in line for founder perks and early updates.
metadata.roadmapDescription: The full story of dIKta.me: from V1 (Python + Electron) to V2 (native C# + WinUI 3), and the ambitious modular future planned in V2.1+.

RoadmapPage.tl1Item2: Multimodal support: Gemini Vision, GPT-4o, and local models with vision capabilities.

RoadmapPage.tl3Subtitle: A dedicated workspace that turns your meetings into structured, searchable artifacts.
RoadmapPage.tl3Item1: One-click session recording with automatic speaker diarization.
RoadmapPage.tl3Item2: AI-generated summaries, action items, and decisions — locally, privately.

RoadmapPage.tl6Item2: Native tool-calling: query stats, switch modes, recall memory, trigger connectors.

SpecsSection.title: The Specs.
SpecsSection.subtitle: Everything you need to make your voice heard. Nothing you don't.
SpecsSection.g1f1Desc: State-of-the-art local STT with natural tolerance for filler words, stutters, and punctuation.
SpecsSection.g1f2Desc: Intelligent formatting, filler removal, and general knowledge. All local, all private, all fast.
SpecsSection.g1f4Desc: Ultra-fast text injection with native window emulation across every application.
SpecsSection.g1f6Desc: Automatically reduces background volume from other applications during active recording sessions.
SpecsSection.g1f7Desc: No markup, no middleman. Plug in your own OpenAI, Anthropic, or DeepSeek keys directly.
SpecsSection.g1f8Desc: Real-time ES ↔ EN translation integrated at the model level for zero-latency bridging.
SpecsSection.g2f1Desc: 100% local processing with automatic PII and sensitive data scrubbing from all logs.
SpecsSection.g2f2Desc: Secrets and keys are managed via OS-level AES-256 encryption. Never exposed, never raw.
SpecsSection.g2f3Desc: Minimal overlay that stays out of your way. Lives in the system tray when not recording.
SpecsSection.g2f4Desc: Lightweight self-contained .exe built with native C# and WinUI 3. No external runtime required.
SpecsSection.g2f5Desc: Define trigger phrases that auto-expand into full macros, signatures, or templates.
SpecsSection.g2f6Desc: Switch freely between Llama, Mistral, Gemma, or any Ollama-compatible model. No lock-in.
SpecsSection.g2f7Desc: Intelligent session recovery—never lose a word of dictation if a model hangs or crashes.
SpecsSection.g2f8Desc: Hear AI responses, read selections aloud, or listen to translations. Fully local via Kokoro ONNX.
SpecsSection.g3f1Desc: Live streaming speech-to-text via Deepgram for instant cloud transcription with sub-second latency.
SpecsSection.g3f2Desc: No subscriptions. Load credits and use cloud STT + LLM at cost. $5 gets you ~65,000 words.
SpecsSection.g3f3Desc: Guided setup that installs Ollama, downloads models, and configures everything in minutes.
SpecsSection.g3f4Desc: Vulkan-powered Whisper inference for blazing local STT. Falls back to CPU gracefully when needed.
SpecsSection.g3f5Desc: Create your own dictation modes with custom system prompts, model overrides, and hotkey bindings.
SpecsSection.g3f6Desc: Every dictation logged locally in SQLite — word counts, latency, mode used. Your data, queryable.
SpecsSection.g3f7Desc: AI responses and translations read aloud via system notifications. Hear answers without looking.
SpecsSection.g3f8Desc: Inspect every line. No black boxes, no telemetry, no hidden network calls. Built in the open.

AboutPage.title: About dIKta.me
AboutPage.whatP1: dIKta.me is a voice dictation engine for Windows that runs entirely on your machine. Press a hotkey, speak, and your words appear in whatever app you're using — Word, Slack, your browser, a terminal, anything.
AboutPage.whatP2: It's not just transcription. A local AI model cleans up your speech, removes filler words, formats your text, and can even follow instructions like "write this as a professional email" or "translate this to Spanish".
AboutPage.whyP1: Every voice tool out there wants to send your audio to the cloud. They want a monthly subscription. They cap your words. They own your data.
AboutPage.whyP2: dIKta.me was born from a simple frustration: why should I need an internet connection and a recurring payment just to talk to my computer? Your voice is personal. Your ideas are yours. The processing should happen on your hardware.
AboutPage.howP1: dIKta.me V2 is a ground-up rewrite in C# with WinUI 3, designed for performance and a native Windows experience.
AboutPage.howSttDesc: Whisper V3 Turbo running locally via faster-whisper, or cloud streaming via Deepgram
AboutPage.howAiDesc: Any Ollama-compatible model (Gemma, Llama, Mistral) for formatting, cleanup, and intelligence
AboutPage.howTtsDesc: Kokoro ONNX for fully local voice synthesis
AboutPage.howCloudDesc: Optional wallet credits for Deepgram + Gemini Flash when you want cloud speed without managing API keys
AboutPage.howP2: dIKta.me is MIT open source — you can read every line of code and know exactly what's running on your machine.
AboutPage.whoP1: dIKta.me is a solo indie project, co-authored with AI tools. No VC funding, no corporate agenda, no growth-at-all-costs mindset. Just one developer who wanted better voice tools and decided to build them.
AboutPage.supportP1: dIKta.me is independent and self-funded. If you want to help keep it that way:

PrivacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
PrivacyPage.introP1: dIKta.me takes your privacy seriously. Here's the short version:
PrivacyPage.introHighlight: The desktop app is air-gapped. It does not phone home, collect telemetry, or transmit your voice data anywhere.
PrivacyPage.introP2: This policy covers how the dIKta.me website and optional cloud features handle your data.
PrivacyPage.desktopP1: The dIKta.me Windows application processes all voice data locally on your machine. No audio recordings or transcriptions are sent to any server unless you explicitly enable cloud features (wallet mode with Deepgram/Gemini). API keys are stored using OS-level AES-256 encryption. Local Whisper processing never contacts external services.
PrivacyPage.websiteP1: This website (dikta.me) collects minimal data necessary for operation:
PrivacyPage.websiteItem1: Account data: If you create an account (email, name), it's stored in Supabase (our auth provider)
PrivacyPage.websiteItem2: Waitlist: Name and email if you join the waiting list
PrivacyPage.websiteItem3: Analytics: Vercel Speed Insights for Core Web Vitals (no personal data, no cookies)
PrivacyPage.websiteP2: We do not sell your data. We do not share it with third parties for marketing. We do not use tracking cookies.
PrivacyPage.cloudP1: If you choose to use wallet-based cloud features:
PrivacyPage.cloudItem1: Audio is sent to Deepgram for STT processing, subject to Deepgram's privacy policy
PrivacyPage.cloudItem2: Text may be sent to Google Gemini Flash for LLM processing, subject to Google's terms
PrivacyPage.cloudItem3: Wallet transactions are processed through our Supabase edge functions
PrivacyPage.cloudP2: Cloud features are entirely optional. The app works fully offline with local models.
PrivacyPage.yourDataItem1: You can delete your account at any time from the dashboard
PrivacyPage.yourDataItem2: All associated data will be permanently removed
PrivacyPage.yourDataItem3: Local app data stays on your machine and is never uploaded

TermsPage.title: Terms of Service
TermsPage.introP2: dIKta.me is a voice dictation engine for Windows. These terms govern your use of the software and the dikta.me website.
TermsPage.licenseP1: dIKta.me is MIT licensed open source software. You are free to use, modify, and distribute it. The Full Version unlocks local AI providers and BYOK in the official installer.
TermsPage.licenseP2: The free tier provides access to cloud-powered features via wallet credits. Credits are non-transferable.
TermsPage.pricingP1: The Full Version is a one-time purchase. No subscriptions, no recurring fees. The price may change for future versions, but your purchase covers the version you buy.
TermsPage.pricingP2: Wallet credits for cloud features (Deepgram STT, Gemini LLM) are purchased separately and consumed on a pay-as-you-go basis. Credits do not expire but are non-refundable.
TermsPage.privacyP1: Your privacy is core to dIKta.me. The desktop app does not collect telemetry or transmit data unless you opt into cloud features. See our Privacy Policy for full details.
TermsPage.disclaimerP1: dIKta.me is provided "as is". While we strive for accuracy and reliability, voice recognition and AI processing may produce incorrect results. The software is not suitable for medical, legal, or safety-critical transcription without human review.
TermsPage.supportP1: Updates are provided at the developer's discretion. Bug fixes and security patches are prioritized. Feature requests can be submitted through GitHub issues.
TermsPage.terminationP1: You can delete your account at any time. We reserve the right to suspend accounts that abuse cloud services or violate these terms.

FaqCard.title: Common Questions
FaqCard.subtitle: The short answers. No fluff.
FaqCard.a1: Yes. With local models (Whisper + Ollama + Kokoro), everything runs on your machine. No internet needed.
FaqCard.q2: Is it really free to try?
FaqCard.a2: Yes. The free trial includes cloud credits so you can try all 8 modes right away. When credits run out, top up or upgrade to local mode for unlimited offline use.
FaqCard.a3: For now. Mac is planned for a future version. Windows-first because native OS hooks give the best dictation experience.
FaqCard.q4: Why $20 one-time instead of a subscription?
FaqCard.a4: Your hardware does the heavy lifting. There are no cloud servers to pay for in local mode, so there is nothing to charge monthly for.
FaqCard.a5: One developer. MIT open source. 1,134 tests. No VC funding, no investor pressure. The code is public — audit every line.
